items.title: Ocean Swift Intros Dev Ocean Modular Synthesis & Sound Design Environment
items.excerpt: Ocean Swift released DevOcean Modular, a 145-module software modular synthesis and sound-design environment. Its standout feature is MaYa, a built-in modular AI agent that patches alongside the user, suggesting and wiring modules during the creative process. It is an early example of a generative AI 'co-patcher' embedded directly inside a modular synth workflow rather than a text-to-song generator. Available now for EUR 129.99 (35% off EUR 199 MSRP until September 1, 2026).

items.title: Spotify expands its AI push with a ChatGPT-like music assistant
items.excerpt: Spotify launched a conversational AI assistant for Premium subscribers that lets listeners chat by voice or text to discover and control music, podcasts and audiobooks. Available in beta on iOS and Android in the US, Ireland and Sweden for users 18+, it blends Spotify's own AI with third-party language models. Users can ask about a song, query their listening history, get recommendations and steer playback through back-and-forth conversation - pushing AI-driven discovery well beyond the existing AI DJ.

items.title: 90,000 AI tracks flood Deezer daily - passing 50% of all new music uploads for the first time
items.excerpt: Deezer revealed that fully AI-generated music topped 50% of daily uploads for the first time in June 2026, with roughly 90,000 AI tracks arriving each day - up from 75,000 in April. The platform says up to 85% of streams from such tracks were fraudulent, and it is removing AI content used for stream manipulation as well as tracks with no plays in six months. A concrete data point on how generative AI is reshaping what lands on streaming and how listeners encounter it.

items.title: BandLab Technologies buys Aiode, an AI music studio built on 'fully-licensed' audio
items.excerpt: BandLab Technologies acquired Aiode, an AI-powered music studio that lets creators build tracks using audio-to-audio models developed with professional session musicians. Its distinguishing pitch is that 100% of the audio used to train its models is licensed and traceable. Creators can generate performances section by section, spin up alternate takes and export projects as stems or full mixes - positioning it as a 'responsible' route for making music with AI.

items.title: Lorde slams Spotify's 'About the Song' feature over inaccurate AI-generated descriptions
items.excerpt: Lorde publicly criticized Spotify's beta 'About the Song' feature, which uses AI to generate song descriptions from third-party sources, after it published inaccurate details about her track 'Current Affairs.' She argued that reducing a song to an AI-generated meaning 'right at the source' limits free interpretation, and called for an artist opt-out. Spotify acknowledged the complaint and removed the offending text - a flashpoint over AI mediating how listeners understand music.

items.title: Fender Studio Pro 8.1 review: AI stem separation, generation and a Studio Assistant land in Fender's DAW
items.excerpt: MusicTech reviews Fender's free Studio Pro 8.1 DAW, which now leans heavily on AI: a Moises-powered engine handles both stem separation and stem generation, alongside voice replacement and AI vocal pitch-correction. A new beta 'Studio Assistant' chatbot (Pro+ tier) answers production questions inside the app. It marks a mainstream, no-cost DAW folding Moises-grade AI directly into the mixing/mastering workflow rather than as an add-on.

items.title: iZotope VEA - one-knob AI vocal enhancement built from RX and Nectar tech - is free until July 31
items.excerpt: iZotope is giving away VEA (normally $29), a stripped-down vocal-enhancement plugin that repackages the AI-assisted processing from its RX, Ozone and Nectar suites into three controls - Clean, Shape and Boost - for de-noising, tone-shaping and presence. Aimed at podcasters, streamers and producers who want RX-grade cleanup without the deep interface, it lowers the barrier to iZotope's machine-learning audio tools. The free window runs through July 31, 2026, tied to Boris FX's acquisition of iZotope.
